Acquisition of Land Act 1984
ACQUISITION OF LAND (FEES) ORDER 20011
Approved by Tynwald: 19 June 2001
Coming into Operation: 1 July 2001
In exercise of the powers conferred on the Treasury by section 3 (4) of the Acquisition of
Land Act 19841, and of all other enabling powers, the following Order is hereby made: —
1 Citation and commencement
This Order may be cited as the Acquisition of Land (Fees) Order 2001 and subject
to the approval of Tynwald, shall come into operation on the 1st July 2001.
2 Fees for official arbitrators
The following fees shall be paid to official arbitrators appointed under section 3
(2) of the Acquisition of Land Act 1984, namely, where the arbitrator holds one or
more of the qualifications specified in the Schedule, the fees specified in the
column of the following table: —
Qualified Arbitrator
Reference fee (payable on the reference of £65.00
any question to the arbitrator for
determination)
Hearing fee per hour for all time spent in £150.00
connection with arbitration, whether at a
hearing or otherwise
3 Expenses
There shall be paid to the arbitrator the amount of the expenses reasonably
incurred by him in —
(a) hiring a room for the proceedings; and
(b) travelling to and from the land for the purpose of a view.
